name: Post-matric scholarship
description: Central and state post-matric scholarships for students pursuing studies beyond Class X. The demo uses the central income ceiling so the check is concrete and verifiable.
illustrative_rules: The student must be enrolled post-matric (Class XI and above, including college). The family's annual income from all sources must not exceed Rs 2,50,000 per year (NSP post-matric income ceiling). The income certificate must be current — an expired certificate must be reissued. The name on every document should match the Aadhaar, with initials and word-order differences tolerated.
notes: Income ceiling and income-certificate validity are state-specific. The demo encodes the Rs 2,50,000 post-matric ceiling and treats validity as an illustrative rule — verify the current requirement on the official portal before relying on this.

process.name: Post-matric scholarship application review
process.description: Before you submit to the NSP or the state portal, we check that every required document is present, readable, current and consistent.

name_check.description: The applicant's name must be consistent across all documents. Initials and word order are acceptable; a different spelling or a completely different person is a problem.

requirements.name: Income ceiling
requirements.message: The annual family income on the income certificate (Rs {{value}}) is above the Rs 2,50,000 post-matric ceiling.
requirements.suggestion: Renew the income certificate for the current assessment year, or contact the scheme helpline if you believe the application is correct.

requirements.name: Income certificate validity
requirements.message: The income certificate appears to have expired.
requirements.suggestion: Obtain a fresh income certificate from the revenue department / Mandal Revenue Officer and re-upload it.

required_document_messages.aadhaar: Aadhaar card — to prove identity and date of birth.
required_document_messages.income_certificate: Income certificate — to prove the family earns within the scheme's ceiling.
required_document_messages.marks_memo: Marks memo or grade sheet — to verify the course and institution.
required_document_messages.bonafide_certificate: Bonafide certificate from the institution — to prove current enrolment.
required_document_messages.bank_passbook: Bank passbook — scholarship amounts are credited directly to this account.

states.label: Upload documents
states.description: Upload Aadhaar, income certificate, marks memo, bonafide certificate and bank passbook.

states.label: Check documents
states.description: Comparing every document against the scheme's requirements with deterministic rules; the AI adds advisory notes only.

states.label: Attention needed
states.description: One or more documents need your attention before submission. Fix the document, or acknowledge and continue as the human in charge.

states.label: Final review
states.description: Final human approval. Nothing is submitted without your explicit consent.

states.label: Submit application
states.description: Submitting the assembled application (simulated in the demo).

states.label: Submission blocked
states.description: A hard requirement failed. The application was NOT submitted.

states.label: Cancelled
states.description: The applicant chose not to submit.

states.label: Application ready
states.description: The reviewed application is ready to submit.
